assets.name: hero-clean
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: main hero photograph for NOIR ROSÉ luxury pharmacy and skincare storefront. Create a remarkably clean, elegant luxury skincare campaign still life. Only two unbranded objects: one refined matte black serum dropper bottle and one low translucent dusty-rose glass cream jar with a slim satin-black lid, arranged close together in the central 30 percent of the image on a seamless warm ivory surface. Light warm ivory background, subtle architectural daylight gradient, a single soft long shadow, exquisite real glass and matte materials. Generous uncluttered negative space on both sides and above. Quiet luxurious editorial photography, natural proportions, crisp refined details, restrained contrast, subtle rose color. Landscape 16:9 composition; both products entirely inside the central region with generous vertical margins so center cropping on mobile retains them. No text, no logos, no watermark, no flowers, no petals, no rocks, no plinths, no decoration. The image should feel airy, premium and polished.

assets.name: hero-luxury
assets.prompt: Create a photorealistic ultra-luxury skincare campaign hero photograph for NOIR ROSÉ pharmacy and beauty boutique. Wide landscape composition 1536x1024. A magnificent but extremely restrained still life: one tall satin black cylindrical skincare serum bottle with a polished pale rose-gold narrow collar, one squat translucent smoked blush glass cream jar with a black lid, and one small ivory porcelain dish with a sculptural dab of cream. Arrange on a low monolithic honed ivory travertine pedestal. One flowing ivory silk ribbon crosses the stone softly, no flowers. Background seamless warm off-white architectural studio with a large diffuse vertical light gradient, refined shadows, subtle blush reflections. Palette white and ivory dominant with striking deep black objects and restrained luminous rose accents. Luxury fragrance campaign photography, tactile materials, soft directional morning light, exquisite glass reflections, sophisticated minimalist art direction, medium-format camera detail. Group occupies middle 50 percent of the frame with generous breathing room on all sides, every bottle completely visible and centered for mobile crops. Clean expensive quiet elegance. NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermark, NO additional packaging, no clutter, no gold glitter. This is the image only, not a website mockup.
assets.refinement_prompt: Refine this exact luxury skincare photograph for a wide website banner. Keep the same black bottle, rose glass cream jar, ivory cream dish, silk ribbon, travertine and lighting, same photorealistic quality. Recompose to a panoramic 1536x768 image with more breathing room above and below. Entire black bottle including its cap must be fully visible with generous headroom. Keep all three products tightly grouped in the central 45 percent of image width and central 50 percent of image height, so the scene survives wide desktop and portrait mobile crops. Extend the ivory studio surroundings smoothly. Quiet high-end elegance. No text, no logos, no additional products.

assets.name: ritual-luxury

Place jar on a single low wide ivory limestone plinth with very fine subtle texture. Large soft directional daylight from upper left, delicate long diffused shadow to right, sophisticated gentle gold highlights, crisp realistic product details. Airy restrained premium beauty campaign art direction, generous balanced negative space all around, quiet warm neutral palette. No flowers, no leaves, no cloth, no extra products, no ornaments, no sparkles, no borders. Avoid cold gray background, harsh shadows, oversized product and excessive empty space above.
